> Bill

parts:
Hi Bill,
Is this what you want?


dat <- read.table(textConnection("Ind   Dep1 Dep2

10      9       2"), header=TRUE)
closeAllConnections()
library(ggplot2)
dat <- melt(dat, id="Ind")

ggplot(dat, aes(x=Ind, y=value, color=variable)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method="lm")

-Ista
